findings.title: Reschedule cancellation bypasses the new cancelled-state fallback
findings.body: handleNewBooking cancels reminders from the original booking with immediateDelete = true. That path in deleteScheduledEmailReminder only calls SendGrid and neither sets WorkflowReminder.cancelled nor deletes the local reminder. If the SendGrid cancellation fails (for example because of the pending-cancellation limit this PR addresses), there is no cron fallback and the old reminder can still be sent for a rescheduled booking. The promise is also not awaited.

findings.title: immediateDelete leaves the WorkflowReminder unchanged
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder's immediateDelete branch returns after the SendGrid request without updating or deleting the WorkflowReminder row. Callers that do not cascade-delete the reminder (for example the reschedule path) leave a stale scheduled reminder, and if the external cancellation fails there is no state that can be retried or cleaned up by the cron job.

findings.title: Paid booking cancellation skips workflow reminder cancellation
findings.body: In the paid booking branch the handler returns before reaching the workflow reminder cancellation loop. Canceled/refunded paid bookings therefore do not cancel scheduled workflow emails or SMS, so reminders can still be sent.

findings.title: Reminder cancellations are fire-and-forget
findings.body: The reminder cancellation loop calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder inside forEach without awaiting them. The request can finish before the database updates or external cancellations complete, which is especially risky in serverless environments; cancellations may be lost and reminders may still be sent.

findings.title: Reschedule request does not await reminder cancellations
findings.body: requestReschedule calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder inside forEach without awaiting them. The mutation can return before cancellations complete, so if the environment terminates work after the response or a call fails, old reminders may remain and be sent.

findings.title: Workflow deletion does not await external reminder cancellations
findings.body: When deleting a workflow, scheduled reminder cancellations are started in a forEach and not awaited before workflow.deleteMany runs. Cascade deletion can remove the reminder rows and the request can end before the SendGrid/Twilio cancellation completes; if the external cancel fails, scheduled messages for a deleted workflow may still be sent.

findings.title: A single failing SendGrid cancel aborts cancellation of all cancelled reminders
findings.body: The cron cancellation loop awaits each SendGrid cancellation inside a single try/catch. If any reminder fails (null or invalid referenceId, SendGrid error, rate limit, etc.), control jumps to the catch and the remaining cancelled reminders are not canceled or deleted. Because the failing reminder remains in the table, subsequent runs can repeatedly stop at the same reminder, leaving other emails to be sent.

findings.title: Delayed cron cancellation leaves a race window where emails can still be sent
findings.body: Cancellations are only processed by a cron job every 15 minutes. If a booking is canceled shortly after a cron run and a reminder is scheduled to send before the next run, the reminder will still be sent. This leaves a last-minute cancellation race even though the booking is canceled.

findings.title: SMS cancellation has no fallback when Twilio cancel fails
findings.body: deleteScheduledSMSReminder only deletes the reminder after a successful Twilio cancellation. If twilio.cancelSMS throws, the error is logged and the reminder remains scheduled, and there is no cancelled flag or cron retry for SMS. A transient Twilio failure can therefore cause SMS reminders for canceled or rescheduled bookings to be sent.

findings.title: Cancel query does not filter by EMAIL or non-null referenceId
findings.body: The query for reminders to cancel does not restrict to EMAIL reminders or require a non-null referenceId. If a SMS reminder or a reminder with a null referenceId ever has cancelled = true, the code will pass that referenceId to SendGrid, likely causing an error that aborts the cancellation loop.

findings.title: Workflow update ignores asynchronous reminder maintenance
findings.body: The workflow update mutation starts asynchronous reminder cancellation and creation in map/forEach callbacks without awaiting them. The mutation can return before those operations finish, causing inconsistent reminder state, silent failures, and unhandled promise rejections.
